comments.author: Jiro
comments.body_html:
The problem is that The custom item mod is loaded after BatterySystem in the server. How 2 fix:
1. Navigate to SPT-AKI/user/mods

2. Open up order.json

3. Make sure BatterySystem is loaded AFTER custom electronics:

{ “order”: [ “zHCO”, “AnyOtherCustomSightMod”, “Jiro-BatterySystem” ] }Custom electronics will default to using CR2032 battery.
